_note: Ukrainian; see topbar.json and docs/translating.md. Edit › Themes: the themes' list and its menus, the versions switch and line, the templates' keys, pictures and menus, the version sheet, and the box menus of the Bible translations' rows. A theme is a тема (feminine: Основна, Вбудована), a template a шаблон, a version a версія; the example version is Пожертва (the offering), and communion is вечеря Господня, as Ukrainian Baptist churches say. Names the app gives and saves (Template 2, the built-in templates) are plain Ukrainian.
